newsitem.title: USA: QUEEN SAND SETS BANK FINANCING.
newsitem.headline: QUEEN SAND SETS BANK FINANCING.

text.p: Queen Sand Resources Inc said Thursday it has obtained a $75 million loan facility from the Bank of Montreal in Houston, with availability restricted by a borrowing base.
The loan is initially a two year interest only revolving credit facility followed by a four-year term. The initial borrowing base has been set at $17 million, the company said.

"This credit facility satisfies our current requirements of approximately $13 million, including the financing for the property acquisition from Collins and Ware Inc, which closed Aug. 1, 1997," Queen Sand said.
The properties, purchased for $6 million in cash and one million shares common stockm consist of proved resources of 1.6 billion cubic feet of natural gas and 773,000 barrels of oil.
Operating revenue from the properties, net to the company, is expected to average $155,000 per month in 1997, it said.

The credit facility also provides unused borrowing capacity of about $4 million which will more than provide financing for development capital expenditures over the next 12 months, said Queen Sand said.
An Enron Corp unit has a 33 percent interest in Queen Sand.

Since inception in 1994, Queen Sand has invested some $26 million to complete 11 property acquisitions involving 240 net producing oil and gas wells in the southwestern United States. Including the acquisition from Collins and Ware, management estimates that the company has daily production averaging 1,350 barrels of oil equivalent and monthly net operating revenue exceeding $475,000.
